title: Gold Coin Pack
description: Replaces the Gold Nugget texture with a gold coin.
body:
# **Gold Coin Resource Pack**

This resource pack **replaces the Gold Nugget** with a **Gold Coin** in Minecraft. The texture of the nugget is modified to look like a coin, and it is renamed to **"Gold Coin"** in various languages based on the user's settings.

### **Key Features:**
- **Texture Change:** The **Gold Nugget** is replaced by a **Gold Coin** with a custom-designed texture.
- **Name Change:** The item is renamed to **"Gold Coin"** in your Minecraft game in the following languages:
  - English (US & UK)
  - Polish (Złota Moneta)
  - German (Goldmünze)
  - French (Pièce d'or)
  - Spanish (Moneda de oro)
  - Italian (Moneta d'oro)
  - Portuguese (Moeda de Ouro)
  - Dutch (Gouden munt)
  - Russian (Золотая монета)
  - Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) (金币, 金幣)
  - Japanese (金貨)
  - Korean (금화)
  - Turkish (Altın Para)
  - Czech (Zlatá mince)
  - Hungarian (Aranypénz)
  - Finnish (Kultakolikko)
  - Swedish (Guldmynt)
  - Danish (Guldmønt)
  - Greek (Χρυσό Νόμισμα)
  - Hebrew (מטבע זהב)
  - Thai (เหรียญทอง)
  - Ukrainian (Золота монета)
